title: Missing `--no-cache-filter` argument to `build`?
body: Is it planned to mirror [this useful option](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/buildx/build/#no-cache-filter)? :)

comments.body: Sounds like a neat idea that we can add support for, feel free to send in a PR if you want.

Hi @danishprakash, I'd like to take this on. From looking at the Docker/Buildx reference, --no-cache-filter takes one or more build-stage names and forces those specific stages to skip the build cache, while the rest of the build can still use it — different from the existing --no-cache which disables caching entirely.

My plan:

Add the --no-cache-filter flag to the build command's CLI flags.
Thread it through the build options struct down to where Buildah handles per-stage caching.
Add a test covering a multi-stage build where one stage is filtered and others still hit cache.

Let me know if that approach lines up with how you'd want it done, or if there's existing plumbing for stage-specific options I should reuse.
